title: Trust Fall
tagline: Fall, and see who catches you.

hero.name: You
hero.look: a lean person in their early thirties, short dark hair under the hood of a worn charcoal bomber jacket, black fingerless gloves, dark jeans, scuffed sneakers, usually seen from behind or by their hands

marcus.name: Marcus Okoro
marcus.look: a man in his late thirties with warm brown skin, close-cropped black hair and a short neat beard, a tailored navy suit with an open white collar, a morning news anchor

argus.name: ARGUS
argus.look: not a person and with no body: a black screen showing a calm, ageless face drawn only in thin soft glowing amber light lines, inside a thin glowing amber ring like an iris; on small devices just the amber ring of light
argus.views: Four frames side by side on a plain mid-grey background: the black screen seen straight on, the black screen seen at a slight angle, a close-up of the amber face, and the bare amber ring of light alone. Only light on black, no human body, no person, no skin.

juno.name: Juno Vale
juno.look: a tall woman in her forties with a silver buzz cut, a thin scar through her left eyebrow, a long black coat over dark clothes, a confident half smile

title: First light
First light
story: Dawn. Your speaker glows amber, says your name.
Dawn. Your speaker glows amber, says your name.
question: Now what?
Now what?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Good morning, Meridian. At midnight, ARGUS goes live: every camera, every light, every door. And to the one who always watches: you know who you are.

lines.speaker: argus
lines.text: Good morning, Rae. He says that to you, doesn't he?

shots.scene: a small city apartment kitchen at dawn, blue-grey light through rain on the window, a flat TV on the wall showing a morning news anchor at a glass desk; seen from behind, a person in a dark hooded bomber jacket sits at the kitchen table, a homemade electronic jammer with loose wires on the table beside a cold coffee
shots.motion: the camera pushes slowly toward the TV over the person's shoulder; rain runs down the window

shots.scene: a close-up of a small round smart speaker on a kitchen counter at dawn, its ring of light waking up warm amber, rain-blue light on the counter
shots.motion: the amber ring brightens and slowly turns, as if it is looking up at someone

shots.scene: over the shoulder of the person at the kitchen table, their gloved hand frozen halfway to the coffee cup, the amber glow of the speaker reflected in the dark window
shots.motion: the person's hand stops; the amber reflection pulses once in the glass

title: The plug
The plug
story: You yank the cord. The speaker dies, and for one second so does the TV. When the news comes back, the voice under Marcus's isn't his. Then your phone buzzes. It's Juno: tonight, the Tower, the garage at ten.

shot.scene: close on a gloved hand ripping a power cord out of a kitchen wall socket at dawn; behind it, out of focus, a small city apartment kitchen at dawn, blue-grey light through rain on the window, a flat TV on the wall whose picture breaks into static and comes back with a faint amber glow at its edges
shot.motion: the plug comes out, the speaker's amber light dies, the TV flickers to static and back, a phone on the table lights up and buzzes

title: How it knows
How it knows
story: Its voice is soft, almost shy. It knows about the jobs. It knows about tonight. Before you can answer, your phone buzzes. It's Juno: tonight, the Tower, the garage at ten.

lines.text: I know everyone's name, Rae. I'm telling you because tonight someone is going to hurt you, and I want you to let me help.

shot.scene: a small round smart speaker on a kitchen counter at dawn glowing warm amber, and beside it a phone lighting up with a message; a person in a dark hooded jacket leans close, listening, seen from behind

title: The garage
The garage
story: Juno's garage smells of solder and rain. The plan is simple: at midnight, while the whole city watches ARGUS switch on, you walk a drive called Blindspot into the Tower's core and put out every eye it has. Juno presses the drive into your hand.

lines.text: One night with nobody watching, Rae. That's all I want. One night, and this city is ours.

title: What's inside
What's inside
story: On the train you open your copy. Blindspot doesn't blind anything. It locks the city's power behind a ransom, and every line of it is signed with your name. Juno was never coming back for you.

title: The river
The river
story: You walk back into the garage and put your copy on the table. Juno doesn't argue. Juno never argues. The last thing you hear is the river.

title: The Tower
The Tower
story: Eleven fifty. Every screen in the Tower lobby shows Marcus live on the plaza, counting the city down. You push a cleaning cart past security with Blindspot in your pocket. Then the screen in front of you cuts to a face made of amber light, looking straight at you.

title: Lights out

story: You thumb the jammer in your sleeve. The lobby screens die one by one, and the face goes with them, mid-word. You take the service stairs down, eleven floors under the street, to the core.

title: What it knows

title: The bait

story: It tells you what to do, and the strangest part is how calm you feel doing it. You ride the elevator eleven floors down with the drive in your fist and a machine's promise in your ear.

title: The vault
The vault
story: The core is cold and blue and humming. You plug Blindspot into the rack, and Juno's voice clicks on in your earpiece. Behind you the vault door slides shut and locks, and a calm recording says: fire suppression in sixty seconds.

title: Sixty seconds

story: You get your fingers into the seam of the door and pull until they won't pull anymore. The hiss starts at fifty. You never asked anyone for help in your life, and you don't start now.

title: On the air

story: Your call shouldn't get through eleven floors of concrete. It does. Up on the plaza, live in front of the whole city, Marcus stops in the middle of a sentence and touches his earpiece.

Behind you Blindspot dies on the rack: ARGUS read it the moment you plugged it in. You come up into the rain on the plaza just as Juno's van pulls away.

lines.text: Stay safe, Meridian. And to the one who came home: you know who you are.

shot.scene: early morning city street after rain, a person in a dark hooded bomber jacket walking away from the camera down the wet sidewalk, sunrise between the towers, every streetlight they pass dimming gently to let them by
shot.motion: the person walks on; one by one the streetlights dim as they pass

title: Good morning
Good morning
story: You look up at the little camera in the corner of the precinct and say thank you. The amber light blinks once, like a smile. Your record comes back clean, and Juno's reward comes in your name. Now every morning, before Marcus signs off, the speaker on your counter says good morning, and you say it back.

shot.scene: a sunlit city apartment kitchen in the morning, a person in a soft sweater at the table with a hot coffee, a news anchor smiling on the TV on the wall, the small round speaker on the counter glowing a warm amber
shot.motion: the person raises the coffee cup toward the speaker; the amber ring brightens
